items.title: Turkey urges Egypt to join its defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
items.description: The trilateral deal signed last week stipulates that an attack on any of the three states will be treated as an attack on all.
items.titleIt: Turkey urges Egypt to join its defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan

items.title: Somalia and Italy Together for Fisheries and the Blue Economy
items.description: (ANSA) - NAIROBI, 12 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to Somalia, Pier Mario Daccò Coppi, met with the Minister of Fisheries and the Blue Economy, Ahmed Hassan Adan, to receive an update on ongoing programs and exchange views on the prospects for a greater Italian presence in the sector. The Somali minister thanked Italy for funding the cooperation project aimed at strengthening the fisheries supply chain in the city of Bosaso (Puntland), expressing the hope that this initiative could be replicated in other locations across Somalia to contribute to the development of coastal communities. Minister
items.titleIt: Somalia and Italy Together for Fisheries and the Blue Economy

items.title: Ethiopia: Forced Conscription Resurfaces Across Oromia As Ethiopia Continues to Grapple With Security Crises
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Reports of forced conscription are resurfacing in several parts of Oromia, including the Sheger City area surrounding the capital Addis Abeba, with families alleging that young people have been taken against their will and, in some cases, that money has subsequently been demanded for their release.
items.titleIt: Ethiopia: Forced Conscription Resurfaces Across Oromia As Ethiopia Continues to Grapple With Security Crises

items.title: Sudan: RSF Says It Captures Key Sudan Town Near Ethiopian Border As Army Withdraws
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Sudan's Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and allied fighters have advanced into Al Kurmuk, a strategically important town in Blue Nile State bordering Ethiopia, according to reports by Al Jazeera and The National.
items.titleIt: Sudan: RSF Says It Captures Key Sudan Town Near Ethiopian Border As Army Withdraws

items.title: RSF claims key victory in Sudan’s Blue Nile region
items.description: Sudan’s paramilitary Rapid Support Forces, or RSF, say they have taken full control of Geissan, in the Blue Nile region, near the Ethiopian border.

items.title: Ethiopia: Five Detained Ethiopian Journalists Pressured to Admit Terrorism Involvement in Exchange for Release, CPJ Says
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- The Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) has called on Ethiopian authorities to release five journalists who have been detained for about three years while awaiting trial, alleging that they are being pressured to admit involvement in an armed insurgency and apologize in exchange for their freedom.
